input.body: We are writing to request a review of the $17.50 deduction on order DD-51115, dated 2026-11-04, which was applied with the reason "missing item" for the Jhol Momo. The order ticket lists Jhol Momo, which shows the item was part of the order as placed [DD-51115:ticket_lists_item]. We note that the ticket alone does not show how the order was packed. Our records show the order was ready at 12:55 and picked up at 12:58, so the handoff to the courier took place 3 minutes after the order was ready [DD-51115:pickup_handoff]. Based on this timing, the order left our restaurant with the courier at 12:58. We respectfully ask that you review the deduction and reverse it. We are happy to provide any further information that would help with the review.
